title: RAS: Measuring LLM Safety Through Refusal Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2606.25750v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Repeated safety evaluation of open-weight large language models requires generating and judging responses for many related checkpoints. We introduce RAS (Refusal Alignment Score), a representation-based, reference-relative indicator of harmful-request refusal computed by the five-stage SafeVec procedure. SafeVec extracts layer-wise refusal directions from an aligned reference model, measures their alignment in related targets, and calibrates a score from 0 to 100 using behavioral attack success rates (ASR) from reference and calibration models. Subsequent target scoring uses input forward passes alone. Across 18 held-out variants from the Llama, Gemma, and Qwen families, RAS correlates with $100(1-\mathrm{ASR})$ (Pearson 0.934, Spearman 0.851) and achieves 83.0% pairwise ordering agreement. translated_title: RAS：通过拒绝对齐衡量大语言模型的安全性
translated_abstract: 对开放权重大语言模型进行重复安全评估需要为众多相关检查点生成并评判响应。我们提出了RAS（拒绝对齐分数，Refusal Alignment Score），这是一种基于表示、相对于参考模型的指标，用于衡量模型对有害请求的拒绝能力，由五阶段的SafeVec流程计算得出。SafeVec从对齐的参考模型中提取逐层拒绝方向，测量这些方向在相关目标模型中的对齐程度，并利用参考模型和校准模型的行为攻击成功率（ASR）将分数校准至0到100之间。此后对目标模型的评分仅需输入的前向传播即可完成。在来自Llama、Gemma和Qwen系列的18个留出变体上，RAS与100(1−ASR)高度相关（皮尔逊相关系数0.934，斯皮尔曼相关系数0.851），并实现83.0%的成对排序一致性。在Llama参考模型的五种提示配置下，各方向平均余弦相似度为0.939。当校准ASR已经可用时……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出RAS（拒绝对齐分数），一种基于表示、仅需前向传播即可高效评估大语言模型拒绝有害请求能力的指标，在Llama、Gemma和Qwen系列模型上与真实攻击成功率高度相关。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces RAS (Refusal Alignment Score), a representation-based, reference-relative metric that evaluates LLM safety efficiently using only forward passes, correlating strongly with behavioral attack success rates (Pearson 0.934) across the Llama, Gemma, and Qwen model families.
